title: Retry policy
text: Temporary processing errors may be retried once when the account is active. Retries above the auto-retry limit require human approval.

title: Insufficient funds
text: Insufficient funds: hold the payment and notify the customer; do not retry automatically.

title: Closed account
text: Closed accounts: escalate to the account team; do not retry.

title: Limit exceeded
text: Limit exceeded: escalate for limit review; do not retry.

title: Refund policy
text: Refunds apply only to settled payments, must not exceed the original amount or the refund cap, and require human approval.

title: Duplicate payments
text: Duplicate payments: request a refund for the duplicate amount; require human approval.

title: Customer disputes
text: Customer disputes: request a refund when the amount is within the cap; otherwise escalate.

title: Insufficient evidence
text: If evidence is missing or conflicting, escalate to a human; do not guess.
